research.note: Free shadcn registry of Motion and GSAP animated React primitives, animated icons and full-page catalog showcases.

effects: Tilt Slide Transition: editorial page transition with tilted scaling exit, diagonal clip-path entrance and SplitText reveals via the View Transition API
Cursor Trail Reveal that leaves a trail of images behind the cursor
Scroll Chapters with a scroll position snapped to fixed steps
